name: onchain-data-mcp
description: Blockchain data for EVM chains and Solana: balances, tokens, prices, DeFi, safety checks and RPC.
long_description: Self-hosted MCP server that routes each request across free-tier data vendors (public RPCs, Alchemy, Helius, CoinGecko and more), tracks their quotas, and fails over automatically. Works with no API keys; add keys to unlock more data. A local dashboard runs at http://127.0.0.1:8787/dashboard while Claude is open.

config_dir.title: Config folder
config_dir.description: Where config.toml, secrets.toml and usage data are stored. Must be writable.

dashboard_password.title: Dashboard password
dashboard_password.description: Optional, at least 12 characters (no spaces). Protects the local dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:8787/dashboard.

alchemy_api_key.title: Alchemy API key
alchemy_api_key.description: Optional. EVM RPC, token balances and transfers.

helius_api_key.title: Helius API key
helius_api_key.description: Optional. Solana RPC and token data.

coingecko_api_key.title: CoinGecko API key
coingecko_api_key.description: Optional. Token prices and market data.
